speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Hello. Have you heard about Save the Children?

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: A little bit would like to know more.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Save the Children is a non-governmental organization that promotes children's rights and helps provide support for needy children in developing countries around the world.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Oh I see. How many people around the world help this organization?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Last year, Save the Children helped to provide education, food, shelter, and other basic necessities for more than 155 million children worldwide.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Wow, that is amazing!

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: I'm sure you are aware that throughout the world there are millions of children who lack access to basic needs like food, clean water, good clothing, and education. Save the Children works to help those kids, so that they can grow up to be healthy, happy, and productive adults.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Yes, I am aware. Its truly sad that children are suffering like that. I am truly thankful for organizations like Save the Children are around to help these children out and bless families!

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: I'm also glad that organizations like Save the Children are out there making a difference. As I'm sure you also know, Save the Children is reliant on donations to be able to provide the help they do.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Yes, I know. I often get asked to help out different organizations when checking out at grocery stores and majority of the time I do!

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: That's great! I'd like you to know that if you choose to donate to Save the Children, they are a top-rated charity. Last year, 86% of all donated funds went directly into programs to help needy children.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Glad to hear they are top rated! What happens to the other percentage that does not go to the program?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: About 5% goes to administration costs, while about 9% is spent on fundraising efforts.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: That makes sense. Fundraising is definitely important in getting the word out so that money can be raised for the children.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Would you be willing to make a small donation today? Every little bit helps, and even a donation as small as $1 can go a long way to help in some of the areas where Save the Children provides aid.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: I would definitely love to help. Could I do anything under $1.00 like maybe 50 cents?

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Of course! Donations in any amount are welcome.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Great! I would love to donate 50 cents. I wish I had more but unfortunately I dont at this time.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: I understand. But I really appreciate you donating what you can afford. As I said before, every little bit helps.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Awesome! I am glad that I can at least do something to help out.

speaker: A3POGRWS6CTP4H
text: Thank you again for your kind donation.

speaker: A3DAMU8MTEB7VG
text: Not a problem. Have a blessed night.
